definition: QT Luong (born 1964) is a French-Vietnamese born American photographer known for his work in the U.S. National Parks, as well as for work in the theory of computer vision.
details: In 2022, Luong received the Ansel Adams Award for Conservation Photography from the Sierra Club.

explainer.lead: QT Luong is an American photographer. His work spans photography.

contributions.name: His thesis, in computer vision, introduced the concepts of Fundamental matrix and camera auto-calibration.

timeline.what: He earned a Ph.D. in computer science at University of Paris-Sud in 1992.
Luong left his career as a research scientist at SRI International to become a full-time photographer in 2007.
